blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.
blocks.zh: 在"大语言模型"(LLMs)上所构建的有争议AI系统需要有路由机制,在规模上平衡答答质量和响应延迟. 然而,现有的LLM路由基准假定所有候选模式结果都完全可观察,未充分强调作为一等尺度的耐久性,并且将不同协议的评估与现实世界的环境错配。 我们引入了路由器世界,这是对话GenAI中LLM路由的综合基准. 路由器世界统一371k单回转响应和76k多回转代理轨迹,采用与标准化的LLM-as-judge协议的自然用户交互,并通过以硬件为基底的后置说明将效率与瞬态定价脱钩. 关键的是,路由器World通过两个设置将部分可观察性下的路由正规化:Cold-Start将学习限制在稀少的静态日志上;而Voyager则对连续数据流进行模型化,其中路由决定会塑造未来的培训分布. 评估13个路由基线,我们发现,大多数路由器都过分强调准确性,而忽略了部分可观察性的延迟. 守则和基准数据可供公开查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Conversational AI systems powered by large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate at massive scale, serving millions of user queries per minute across chat assistants Team et al. (2023) ; Llama (2023) ; Chiang et al. (2024) ; Amazon (2025) , search interfaces Chen et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2023) , and interactive agents Yao et al. (2023) ; Wu et al. (2024) ; Qin et al. (2024) . In these settings, every query is user-facing and latency-sensitive. Rather than relying on a single monolithic model, modern conversational systems deploy heterogeneous pools of LLMs that vary widely in capability, specialization, and inference latency. Intelligent routing, which dynamically selects the most appropriate model for each query, has thus emerged as a central mechanism for scaling Generative AI while balancing response quality and cost.
blocks.zh: 由大型语言模型(LLMS)提供动力的对口AI系统日益大规模运行,为聊天助理每分钟提供数百万次用户查询服务 Team等人(2023年);Llama (2023年);Chiang等人(2024年);Amazon (2025年),搜索接口 Chen等人(2025年);Liu等人(2023年),以及互动代理商 姚等人 (2023年); 吴等人 (2024年); 秦等人 (2024年). 在这些设置中,每个查询都是面向用户的,对耐久性有敏感认识. 现代对话系统不依靠单一模式,而是部署各种LLMs,在能力、专业化和推论延迟方面差别很大。 智能路由(英語:Intelligent routing),动态地为每个查询选择最合适的模式,因此成为了在平衡响应质量和成本的同时缩放Generative AI的中央机制.

blocks.en: Recent work has explored various routing strategies, including supervised classifiers trained on offline logs Ong et al. (2025) ; Ding et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2025b) , bandit-based methods that optimize routing policies via online interaction Panda et al. (2025) ; Wei et al. (2025) , and cascade architectures that progressively escalate queries to stronger models Chen et al. (2024) . To facilitate comparison across methods, benchmarks have been proposed Hu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作探索了各种路由战略,包括在离线日志Ong等人(2025年)、Ding等人(2024年)、Feng等人(2025年b年)、通过在线互动优化路由政策的土匪方法Panda等人(2025年)、Wei等人(2025年)以及逐步将查询升级为更强模型的级联结构。 陈等 (2024). 为了便于对各种方法进行比较,提出了Hu等人(2024年);Li等人(2026年); 黄等 (2025).

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing evaluation methodologies for LLM routing remain misaligned with real-world deployment constraints. A central limitation is the widespread assumption of full observability: as illustrated in Figure 1 (Left), standard protocols assume the router has access to correctness and efficiency outcomes of all candidate models per query. This diverges sharply from deployed systems operating at million-scale throughput, where running all candidates per request is prohibitively expensive and incompatible with rapid iteration cycles Chapelle and Li (2011) ; Joachims et al. (2017) . In practice, outcomes of unchosen models remain counterfactual and unavailable for learning. Existing benchmarks also frequently use monetary costs as efficiency proxies Dean and Barroso (2013) , neglecting latency. Because natural dialogue relies on ∼ \sim 200ms inter-turn gaps Stivers et al. (2009) , multi-second delays break conversational fluidity, so evaluation metrics must ground efficiency in stable, hardware-level characteristics.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的LLM路由评价方法仍然与现实世界的部署限制不相符。 一个中心限制是普遍假定完全可观察性:如图1(Left)所示,标准协议假设路由器每个查询都可获得所有候选模型的正确性和效率结果. 这与以百万规模吞吐量运行的部署系统大相径庭,每个请求运行所有候选人的费用高昂,与Chapelle和Li的快速迭代周期不相容。 在实践中,未经选择的模式的结果仍然是相反的,无法学习。 现有基准还经常使用货币成本作为代迪恩和巴罗佐的效率(2013年),忽略了延迟。 因为自然对话依赖于 \ sim 200ms 的回合间差距 Stivers et al. (2009年),多秒延迟打破对话流畅度,因此评价度量必须在稳定,硬件层面的特性中实现地面效率.

blocks.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce RouterWorld , a comprehensive benchmark that aligns LLM routing research with the operational realities of conversational AI. RouterWorld consolidates 53k single-turn core tasks and 17k multi-turn agentic interactions across 7 open-weight LLMs (2B–235B parameters, covering coding, math, reasoning, and chit-chat specialists), for a total of 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn trajectories once every candidate model is run on every task. To reflect deployed input–output characteristics, we replace artifact-heavy task prompts with natural Conversational-Form Queries (CF-Queries) , unify heterogeneous metrics into a binary correctness signal via a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol aligned with human evaluation, and replace volatile commercial pricing with reproducible latency metrics obtained from the GenAI-Perf 1 1 1 https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/triton-inference-server toolkit on controlled hardware.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了路由器世界(RouterWorld),这个综合基准将LLM路由研究与对话AI的操作现实相结合. RouterWorld整合了53k单回合核心任务和17k多回合代理交互,跨越7个开放量级LLMs(2B–235B参数,包括编码,数学,推理,和chit-chat专家),总计371k单回合响应,每个候选模式运行在每个任务上后76k多回合轨道. 为了反映已部署的投入-产出特性,我们用自然对话-形式查询(CF-Queries)取代了文物重任务提示,通过与人类评价相一致的标准化LLM-as-judge协议,将各种计量标准统一成二进制正确信号,并以GenAI-Perf 1 1 1 的可复制延时计量标准取代波动的商业定价。 关于受控硬件的工具包。

blocks.en: Crucially, RouterWorld models the counterfactual nature of routing feedback through two partially observable evaluation paradigms (Figure 1 ). The Cold-Start setup simulates zero-shot initialization, training routers from static historical logs without access to unselected model outcomes. The Voyager mode extends this to a dynamic, life-long learning setting in which routing decisions shape future training data, exposing the system to non-stationary traffic and testing its ability to mitigate self-reinforcing bias through exploration.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,路由器世界通过两个部分可观察到的评价范式(图1 )来模拟路由反馈的反事实性质. Cold-Start设置模拟了零镜头初始化,从静态历史日志中培训路由器,无法访问未选择的模型结果. Voyager模式将它延伸至一个动态的终身学习环境,在这种环境中,路由决定决定塑造未来的培训数据,使系统暴露于非固定交通,并测试其通过探索减轻自我强化偏差的能力.

blocks.en: Benchmarking 13 routing strategies on RouterWorld reveals a pronounced efficiency gap. To jointly measure routing quality and efficiency, we introduce L-DCG , a latency-aware variant of Discounted Cumulative Gain that weighs each correct selection by how close its latency is to the fastest correct model (formal definition in Section 4.4 ). Even under idealized full observability, the strongest baseline reaches only 39.6% latency-penalized accuracy (Acc@1-L) compared to the 68.0% empirical upper bound, capturing just 62% of the optimal efficiency ceiling as measured by L-DCG, indicating substantial headroom in latency-aware routing. This gap widens substantially under more realistic partial observability: deprived of counterfactual feedback, routers usually over-emphasize task accuracy (Acc@1) at the expense of latency, inflating accuracy by an average of 24.7% while overall efficiency deteriorates sharply. In the most extreme case, Avenger Zhang et al. (2025b) , a cluster-voting router, collapses into a degenerate Route-to-Largest policy Lai and Ye (2026) , achieving 89.1% Acc@1 but suffering a 79% reduction in optimal efficiency. These feedback-induced failures persist in the Voyager setting, where standard routers show little improvement across streaming interaction, while bandit-based methods with explicit exploration, such as BaRP Wei et al. (2025) , continue to improve, highlighting observation diversity. These findings motivate the next generation of router design.
blocks.zh: 以路由世界为基准的13项路由战略揭示了明显的效率差距。 为了共同衡量路由质量和效率,我们引入了L-DCG,这是贴现累积增益的一种耐久识别的变体,它以每一正确选择的耐久性接近最快的正确模式来衡量(第4.4节的正式定义)。 即便在理想化的完全可观察性下,最强基线也仅达到39.6%的耐久-惩罚精度(Acc@1-L),而实证上限为68.0%,仅捕获了L-DCG测得的最佳效率上限的62%,表明在耐久-知觉路由中,头部相当大. 这种差距在更现实的局部可观察性下大大扩大:缺乏反事实反馈,路由器通常过分强调任务准确性(Acc@1)而牺牲了耐久性,精度平均膨胀24.7%,而总体效率急剧恶化. 在最极端的情况下,Avenger Zhang等人(2025年b),一个集群投票的路由器,倒塌成一个堕落的Route-to-Largest政策Lai和Ye(2026年),实现了89.1%的Acc@1,但最佳效率却下降了79%. 这些反馈引发的失败在Voyager设定中持续存在,标准路由器在流间互动中显示没有什么改进,而BARP Wei等人(2025年)等有明确探索的强盗方法继续改进,突出观测多样性. 这些发现推动了下一代路由器的设计.

blocks.en: Further, we provide analyses to further clarify routing behavior. We examine long-horizon agentic tasks, where policy collapse emerges through cumulative latency effects rather than single-step decisions (Section 5.3 ), and study warm-up initialization, finding that most routers function as policy distillers rather than independent optimizers (Section 5.4 ). By open-sourcing RouterWorld -Core and RouterWorld -Agentic 2 2 2 RouterWorld-Core and RouterWorld-Agentic datasets. , we provide a scalable, deployment-aligned environment for diagnosing these failures and advancing robust, latency-aware routing for conversational AI.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们提供分析,以进一步澄清路线行为。 我们研究了长远的代理任务,在这些任务中,政策崩溃是通过累积延迟效应而不是单步决定产生的(第5.3节),并研究暖化初始化,发现大多数路由器作为政策提炼器而不是独立优化器发挥作用(第5.4节)。 使用开源路由器 World - Core and Router World - Agenic 2 2 路由器 World-Core和路由器 World-Agendic datas.,我们提供了一个可扩展,可部署的配合环境,用于诊断这些失败,并推进稳健,耐久的路由,用于对话AI.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early LLM routing relied on non-predictive orchestration, where decisions are resolved through iterative execution rather than a single selection step. FrugalGPT Chen et al. (2024) formalizes this via the LLM cascade, escalating queries to progressively stronger models when a confidence threshold is not met. More recent work generalizes this into ensemble-like frameworks: AutoMix Aggarwal et al. (2024) formulates routing as a POMDP with self-verification signals, and Router-R1 Zhang et al. (2025a) instantiates the router as a reasoning LLM that plans multi-step invocations. While flexible, these approaches invoke multiple models per query, leading to compounded inference latency.
blocks.zh: 早期LLM的路由依赖于非预测性的管弦乐,其中决定通过迭代执行而不是单选步骤来解决. 弗鲁加尔GPT 陈等. (2024)通过LLM级联将这一点正式化,当置信阈值未达到时,将查询升级为逐渐更强的模型. 更近期的工作将这一点概括为类聚框架: AutoMix Aggarwal et al. (2024) 将路由定型为具有自我验证信号的POMDP, router-R1 Zhang et al. (2025a) 将路由器作为推理LLM, 规划多步引用. 这些方法虽然灵活,但每个查询都引用多个模型,导致推论的延迟。

blocks.en: Predictive approaches formulate model selection as a single decision made prior to generation. HybridLLM Ding et al. (2024) trains a BERT-based classifier to route between a small and a large model, while RouteLLM ( Ong et al., 2025 ) and Carrot Tsiourvas et al. (2025) learn from preference or reward signals. GraphRouter Feng et al. (2025b) models query–model interactions via graph-based message passing, BaRP ( Wei et al., 2025 ) formulates routing as learning from bandit feedback using REINFORCE-style policy gradients, and Avenger ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) employs train-free cluster-based voting over embedding neighborhoods. IPR Feng et al. (2025a) targets production settings with user-controlled quality–cost trade-offs, and PILOT Panda et al. (2025) explores online contextual bandits with exploration–exploitation schedules tailored to routing.

blocks.en: Despite this variety of methods, almost all predictive routers are designed and evaluated under full observability : at training time, the learner has access to the outcome of every model on every query, reducing routing to supervised learning over complete labels. This assumption underlies RouteLLM ( Ong et al., 2025 ) , HybridLLM Ding et al. (2024) , GraphRouter Feng et al. (2025b) , Carrot Tsiourvas et al. (2025) , Avenger ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , and the Best-of- N N style oracles commonly reported as upper bounds Hu et al. (2024) ; Huang et al. (2025) . While convenient, full observability requires running every model per query, an operational pattern that does not scale to production-scale conversational deployments which preclude exhaustive parallel inference Chapelle and Li (2011) ; Joachims et al. (2017) . It also obscures feedback-loop dynamics (confirmation bias, policy collapse, self-reinforcement) that only emerge when the router’s choices shape the data it subsequently learns from. A few methods acknowledge partial feedback, notably BaRP ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , but its evaluation still assumes rich offline supervision. Our benchmark makes partial observability a first-class evaluation regime and exposes how existing routers behave when counterfactual outcomes are not available.
blocks.zh: 尽管方法多种多样,但几乎所有的预测路由器都是在完全可观察性下设计和评价的:在训练时间,学习者在每个查询上都可获得每个模型的结果,将路由缩短为监督学习,而不是完整的标签. 这一假设基于RouteLLM(Ong等人,2025年),HybridLLM。 Ding等人(2024年),图鲁特 Feng等人(2025年b),Carrot Tsiourvas等人(2025年),Avenger (Zhang等人,2025年b),以及通常被报道为Hu等人(2024年)上界的N型最优风格甲骨文;Huang等人(2025年). 虽然方便但完全可观察性要求每个查询运行每个模型,但这种操作模式并没有达到生产规模的对话部署,排除了详尽的平行推断,Chapelle和Li(2011年);Joachims等人(2017年)。 这也掩盖了反馈-搜索动态(确认偏差、政策崩溃、自我强化),只有当路由器的选择决定了随后从中吸取的数据时才会出现。 少数方法承认部分反馈,特别是BARP(Wei等人,2025年),但其评价仍然假定有丰富的离线监督。 我们的基准使部分可观察性成为一流评价制度,并揭示了现有路由器在无法取得反事实结果时的表现。

blocks.en: Routing methods are typically compared using benchmarks such as RouterBench Hu et al. (2024) , RouterArena Lu et al. (2026) , RouterEval Huang et al. (2025) , and LLMRouterBench Li et al. (2026) , which release precomputed outcomes for many query–model pairs. These resources assume full observability and either omit latency or treat it as a coarse boundary constraint rather than a primary optimization objective. They also rely on raw benchmark prompts and monetary pricing as efficiency proxies, both of which introduce artifacts and drift that are ill-suited to conversational deployment. RouterWorld instead (i) formalizes partial observability via the Cold-Start and Voyager setups, (ii) grounds efficiency in hardware-measured latency that is stable across pricing changes, (iii) adopts natural conversational-form queries, and (iv) spans both single-turn and long-horizon agentic tasks, offering a more deployment-aligned evaluation.
blocks.zh: 通常使用诸如Router Bench Hu等人(2024年)、RouterArena Lu等人(2026年)、Router等基准对运行方法进行比较。 Eval Huang et al. (2025),以及 LLMRouter Bench Li et al. (2026),它们释放了许多查询-模型对的预计算结果. 这些资源具有完全的可观察性,或者省略了暂时性,或者把它视为粗糙的边界限制,而不是首要的优化目标。 他们还依赖原始基准提示和货币定价作为效率代用,两者都引入了不适合对话部署的文物和漂移. 相反,路由世界(一) 通过 " 冷启动 " 和 " Voyager " 设置,使部分可观察性正规化;(二) 硬件计量延迟性的效率在价格变化中保持稳定;(三) 采用自然对话形式查询,以及(四) 跨过单回合和长距离代理任务,提供更符合部署的评价。

blocks.en: 3.2 Fully-Observable LLM Routing
blocks.zh: 3.2 完全可观测LLM 运行

blocks.en: In the fully-observable setting, the router has access to outcomes of all candidate models for each input during training, reducing routing to supervised learning over complete labels. This has been the dominant assumption in the LLM routing literature to date, underlying most predictive routers and benchmarks surveyed in Section 2 (e.g., Ding et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025b ; Tsiourvas et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ). It is convenient for offline analysis but relies on counterfactual outcomes that are typically unavailable in practice without costly offline replay across all candidate models.
blocks.zh: 在完全可观察的设置中,路由器可以在训练期间获得每个输入的所有候选模型的结果,从而减少路由到监督学习的路径超过完整的标签. 这是迄今为止LLM路由文献中的主要假设,是第2节(如丁等人,2024年)所调查的大多数预测路由器和基准的基础; Ong等人,2025年;Feng等人,2025年b;Tsiourvas等人,2025年b;Zhang等人,2025年b;Hu等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年b。 进行离线分析是方便的,但依靠的是反事实结果,如果不在所有候选模型中进行费用高昂的离线重播,这些结果在实践中通常无法实现。

blocks.en: The Cold-Start setting represents the initialization phase of a routing system. The router must learn from a static historical log generated by a uniform random policy, where each task yields a single model outcome (response, latency, and correctness). This evaluates the router’s ability to extract a viable policy from high-entropy, incomplete data in a single offline training round. We explore other warm-up policies in Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh: Cold-Start设置代表了路由系统的初始化阶段. 路由器必须学习统一随机政策产生的静态历史日志,其中每项任务产生一个单一的模型结果(反应、延迟和正确性)。 这评估了路由器在单一的离线训练回合中从高强度,不完整的数据中提取可行的政策的能力. 我们探讨第5.4节中的其他热身政策。

blocks.en: In real-world deployments, routing decisions are made over streaming inputs, and the router’s own policy determines which model outcomes are observed. Voyager mode captures this: training proceeds in iterative stages over temporally ordered data chunks { C 1 , … , C T } \{C_{1},\dots,C_{T}\} . The process is initialized with C 1 C_{1} (ground-truth feedback under an initial random policy); at stage t t , the policy is trained on { C 1 , … , C t } \{C_{1},\dots,C_{t}\} and used to route C t + 1 C_{t+1} , with checkpoint selection on a held-out development set. To keep evaluation reproducible without live model inference, we simulate deployment via a hidden fully-observable engine derived from RouterWorld : it stores outcomes for all candidates but reveals only the feedback corresponding to the router’s selected action.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的部署中,路线决定是通过流式投入做出的,路由器本身的政策决定了遵守何种模式结果. blocks.en: 4 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4 基准建设

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset Selection Principles
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集选择原则

blocks.en: We construct RouterWorld according to four guiding principles: (1) Task Diversity and Balance , spanning six major categories (e.g., math, code, reasoning) to prevent domain skew; (2) Discriminative Power , selecting examples where model performance varies to necessitate intelligent routing; (3) Latency Awareness , integrating real-world timing metrics Yu et al. (2022) ; Kwon et al. (2023) to evaluate trade-offs; and (4) Reproducibility , enforcing strict train-test separation and automatic metrics. Table 1 compares RouterWorld with existing benchmarks. Unlike prior work, our benchmark uniquely combines partial observability, streaming evaluation, and agentic workflows; see Appendix A for a full breakdown.
blocks.zh: 我们按照四项指导原则构建路由器世界: (1) 任务多样性和平衡,涵盖六个主要类别(如数学、代码、推理),以防止域位扭曲;(2) 歧视性力量,选择模型性能不同需要智能路径的例子;(3) 延迟意识,结合现实世界的计时尺度 Yu等人(2022年);Kwon等人(2023年)评价权衡;和(4)可复制性,实施严格的列车测试分离和自动测量. 表1比较了路由器世界与现有基准. 与以前的工作不同的是,我们的基准将部分可观察性、流式评价和代理工作流程综合起来;见附录A。

blocks.en: 4.2 RouterWorld Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 路由器世界基准建设

blocks.en: RouterWorld comprises two complementary subsets. RouterWorld -Core contains single-turn, end-to-end tasks assessing a router’s ability to select appropriate models for standalone queries of varying difficulty. It integrates 12 established benchmarks covering logical and commonsense reasoning ( Zellers et al., 2019 ; Clark et al., 2018 ; Thorne et al., 2018 ; Yang et al., 2018 ) , math ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lu et al., 2023 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) and tool use ( Patil et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) , code generation ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ; Li et al., 2024 ) , data analysis ( Li et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2023 ) , and open-ended chit-chat ( Yamashita et al., 2023 ) . RouterWorld -Agentic focuses on long-horizon, multi-turn agentic tasks that require environment interaction, covering computer use, household assistance, and e-commerce workflows. All benchmarks are standardized into a unified routing evaluation framework; full preprocessing and standardization procedures are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 路由器 世界由两个相辅相成的子集组成。 路由器 World -Core 包含单转,端对端任务,评估路由器是否有能力为不同难度的独立查询选择合适的模型. 它整合了涵盖逻辑推理和常识推理的12个既定基准(Zellers等人,2019年;Clark等人,2018年;Torne等人,2018年;Yang等人,2018年),数学 (Cobbe等人,2021年;Lu等人,2023年;Hendrycks等人,2021年b)和工具使用(Patil等人,2024年;Fan等人,2025年),代码生成(Hendrycks等人,2021年a;Li等人,2024年b),数据分析 (Li等人,2024年;Lu等人,2023年),以及开放式聊天(山下等人,2023年). 路由器 World - Agentic侧重于需要环境互动的长视野,多回合代理任务,涵盖计算机使用,家庭援助以及电子商务工作流程. 所有基准都标准化为一个统一的路线评价框架;完整的预处理和标准化程序载于附录C。

blocks.en: Figure 2 and Table 2 summarize the statistics. RouterWorld-Core contains 48,232 single-turn instances across seven task categories and twelve datasets, with substantial variation in query difficulty and latency that creates meaningful routing opportunities. RouterWorld-Agentic comprises 12,740 multi-turn interactions in three agentic domains and exhibits higher selectivity and longer latency tails. Analysis of task distributions, difficulty, model specialization, and oracle behavior is in Appendix E.1 .

blocks.zh: 4.3 注释

blocks.en: We select 7 popular open-weight models (2B–235B parameters), creating a heterogeneous landscape of capability and inference cost, where latencies range from ∼ \sim 200ms to over 7s. We model E2E latency for query-model pairs ( q , m ) (q,m) using empirically measured Time-To-First-Token ( TTFT m \text{TTFT}_{m} ) and Inter-Token Latency ( ITL m \text{ITL}_{m} ): latency ​ ( q , m ) = TTFT m + ( N q , m − 1 ) × ITL m , \text{latency}(q,m)=\text{TTFT}_{m}+(N_{q,m}-1)\times\text{ITL}_{m}, (1) where N q , m N_{q,m} is the number of tokens generated. For multi-step agentic trajectories, latency is accumulated across all generation steps. Since raw response and trajectory tokens are released for each task, the framework can be easily adapted to monetary cost. Full profiling workflow and model specifications are in Appendices D.1 and D .

blocks.en: Source datasets employ heterogeneous evaluation metrics, and individual models often require distinct prompting and post-processing pipelines. To streamline the setup and comparison while mitigating biases introduced by dataset-specific metrics and prompt engineering, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge framework that produces a standardized binary judgment ( correct or incorrect ) for each model output via a strong LLM, i.e. Claude-4.5-Sonnet . This binary signal is intended to approximate coarse-grained user feedback in interactive systems, where users typically either adopt a satisfactory response or reject it to ask a follow-up query, rather than providing dense or calibrated rewards Amershi et al. (2019) ; Ouyang et al. (2022) . We validate this protocol through a blind expert annotation study on 150 (query, model, response) triples: six PhD-level annotators achieve high inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss’ κ = 0.84 \kappa{=}0.84 , Krippendorff’s α = 0.87 \alpha{=}0.87 ), and the LLM judge matches the 6-expert majority-vote consensus at κ = 0.84 \kappa{=}0.84 (F1 = 0.93 {=}0.93 , 92% agreement), approaching the human ceiling and consistent with prior LLM-judge evaluations ( Zheng et al., 2023b ) . Full validation details are provided in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 原始数据集采用不同的评价衡量标准,单个模型往往需要不同的提示和处理后管道。 为了简化设置和比较,同时减轻数据集特定计量和即时工程带来的偏差,我们采用了LLM-as-a-Judge框架,通过强大的LLM,即Claude-4.5-Sonnet,为每个模型输出产生标准化的二进制判断(正确或不正确)。 这种二进制信号意在在交互系统中对粗糙的用户反馈进行近似,用户通常要么通过满意的回复,要么拒绝询问后续查询,而不是提供密集或校准的奖励Amershi等人(2019年);Ouyang等人(2022年). 我们通过盲目专家对150(清、模型、反应)的三重注释研究来验证这项协议:6名博士级注释员达成高注释员协议(Fleiss ' $ = 0.84\kappa{=}0.84,Krippendorff's α = 0.87\alpha{=}0.87),LLM法官与6位专家的多数投票共识一致为0.84\\kappa 0.84 (F1 = 0.93, 92%协议),接近人上限,并符合先前LLM法官的评价(郑等人,2023b)。 完整的验证细节见附录H。

blocks.en: Real user inputs to voice assistants are typically brief and goal-oriented rather than carefully structured prompts. Further, since benchmarks have been publicly accessible for years, downstream LLMs are susceptible to data contamination and may have memorized surface-level queries and prompt formats during pre-training Tseng et al. (2025) ; Golchin and Surdeanu (2024) ; Sainz et al. (2023) , artificially inflating performance and introducing spurious signals that mislead routers. We therefore apply a multi-stage transformation pipeline: original prompts establish task specifications; a strong external LLM ( DeepSeek-V3.1 , excluded from the routing pool) rewrites each as a natural user query; rewritten queries are validated against the original specs, with semantically drifted ones filtered out Li et al. (2025) ; Zheng et al. (2023a) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Madaan et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 真正的用户对语音助理的投入通常是简短和面向目标的,而不是精心安排的提示。 此外,由于基准已公开多年,下游有限责任公司容易受到数据污染,在培训前Tseng等人(2025年);Golchin和Surdeanu(2024年);Sainz等人(2023年),人为地夸大性能,引入误导路由器的虚假信号。 因此,我们采用多阶段转换管道:原始提示确定任务规格;强大的外部LLM(DeepSeek-V3.1,不包括在路由池内)将每个管道重写为自然用户查询;重写查询根据原始的规格进行验证,对Li等人(2025年)进行精密漂移;郑等人(2023a年); Wang et al. (2023); Madaan et al. (2023).

blocks.en:
We benchmark 13 popular routing algorithms across categories.
(1) Naive routers provide reference bounds, including Random selection, Always-Route-To-Largest (always picking the largest candidate model, regardless of query) and Always-Route-To-Smallest (always picking the smallest), as well as two oracle
upper bounds: Oracle (Perfect) , which selects the optimal downstream model with
full knowledge of all candidate outcomes, and Oracle (Best-of- N N ) , which, for each
query, picks the best downstream model among the N N models that at least one evaluated
router selects on that query, representing an empirical (rather than theoretical) upper
bound attainable by any router in our suite.
(2) Representation-based routers learn a query representation and route based
on similarity, classification, or learned utility in embedding space. This category
covers classical methods operating on frozen embeddings ( KNN , MLP ),
end-to-end representation fine-tuning ( Emb-FT ), and more structured or hybrid
architectures such as Hybrid-LLM Ding et al. (2024) , BaRP Wei et al. (2025) , GraphRouter Feng et al. (2025b) , as well as Avenger Zhang et al. (2025b) .
(3) Generative routers use autoregressive language models to directly select a
target model via prompting or supervised fine-tuning on routing data.
Detailed architectures and training configurations for all baselines are provided in
Appendix G .

blocks.en: We evaluate all methods under two regimes: (1) Fully Observable , where the training set contains ground-truth correctness and latency for every candidate model; and (2) Partially Observable , where each query is annotated with the outcome of only one random model.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两种制度下的所有方法:(1) 完全可观察,其中培训集包含每个候选模式的地面真实正确性和耐久性;(2) 部分可观察,其中每个查询仅附加一个随机模式的结果。

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on 8 × 8\times NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Since most routing algorithms require a query encoder, we standardize on Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (1024-dim, mean-pooled, max sequence length 512) across all methods for a fair comparison. For methods that require architecture-specific encoders (such as Hybrid-LLM which relies on DeBERTa’s [CLS] token representation) we retain their original encoder as prescribed by the respective papers.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在8×8\times NVIDIA H200 GPU上进行的. 由于大多数路由算法都需要一个查询编码器,所以我们在所有方法上将Qune3-Embedding-0.6B(1024-dim,平均集合,最大序列长度512)标准化,以便进行公平的比较. 对于需要特定架构编码器的方法(例如依赖于DeBERTa的[CLS]符号表示的Hybrid-LLM),我们保留了各自文件规定的原始编码器。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3: Performance on RouterWorld -Core under fully- and partially-observable settings. Oracle (Perfect) and Oracle (Best-of-8) denote theoretical and empirical upper bounds, respectively. Orange cells indicate collapsed routing that always selects a single model and are excluded from best/second-best comparisons. All pairwise improvements of the best-performing method over the second-best baseline are statistically significant ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 表3 路由器World上的性能 - 在完全和部分可观测的设置下Core. 甲骨文(英語:Perfect)和甲骨文(英語:Best-of-8)分别表示理论和实证上限. 橙色细胞表示坍塌的路由,总是选择一个单一的模型,并且被排除在最佳/次最佳比较之外. 在统计学上,最佳方法相对于第二最佳基线的双向改进都是有意义的(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: RouterWorld poses a substantial challenge for existing routers (Table 3 ). Under full observability, the empirical upper bound Oracle (Best-of-8) achieves 67.97% Acc@1-L / 0.7140 L-DCG, whereas the strongest non-oracle baseline Gen-SFT (Qwen-2.5-1.5B-ins) reaches only 39.61% Acc@1-L / 0.4439 L-DCG, leaving a large gap in latency-aware routing. Effective routing requires context-aware decision-making rather than coarse model attributes, as Route-To-Largest attains 89.11% Acc@1 but just 9.10% Acc@1-L
blocks.zh: 路由器World对现有路由器构成巨大挑战(表3)。 在完全可观察性下,实证上界甲骨文(Best-of-8)实现67.97%的Acc@1-L / 0.7140 L-DCG,而最强的非甲骨文基线Gen-SFT(Quen-2.5-1.5B-ins)仅达到39.61%的Acc@1-L / 0.4439 L-DCG,在延迟感知路由上留下了很大的缺口. 有效的路由需要上下文决策,而不是粗糙的模型属性,因为路由到大型的路由达到89.11% Acc@1,但只有9.10% Acc@1-L

blocks.en: Transitioning to partial observability drives a drastic shift: on average, Acc@1 inflates by 24.7 pp while L-DCG drops by over 0.16. Without cross-model comparisons, routers cannot determine whether a faster model would have also been correct, and become risk-averse (favoring accuracy at the cost of latency). In the extreme, Avenger collapses into Route-To-Largest (89.11% Acc@1, 0.1494 L-DCG), losing any ability to navigate efficiency trade-offs, a fundamental challenge that RouterWorld explicitly captures.
blocks.zh: 向局部可观察性过渡导致急剧转变:平均而言,Acc@1充气24.7页,L-DCG下降0.16以上。 如果没有跨模型的比较,路由器无法确定一个更快的模型是否也是正确的,并且会变成规避风险(以耐久为代价的有利准确性). 在极端情况下,复仇者倒闭进入了路由-至负载(89.11% Acc@1,0.1494 L-DCG),失去了任何导航效率权衡的能力,这是路由世界明确抓住的根本挑战.

blocks.en:
To illustrate the necessity of domain-specific training data, we probe Generative AI Routers. Zero-shot prompting with explicit latency profiles severely underperforms (Qwen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct: 7.38% Acc@1-L, 0.1211 L-DCG), while SFT on the RouterWorld corpus drives Acc@1-L to 37.55% and L-DCG to 0.4282.
This shows that routing cannot be reduced to a linear relationship between model size and query difficulty: in ∼ \sim 27% of cases, lightweight models like Gemma-2-2b exhibit verbose generation patterns that yield higher latency than larger models. LLM routing is a complex, non-linear decision-making process that requires internalizing empirical interaction logs.
blocks.zh:
为了说明特定领域培训数据的必要性,我们探索了Generative AI路由器. 零射线带有明显的潜伏性剖面(Quen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct:7.38% Acc@1-L,0.1211 L-DCG),而路由器世界仪上的SFT驱动Acc@1-L为37.55%,L-DCG为0.4282.
这表明路由不能缩小为模型大小与查询难度之间的线性关系:在\sim 27%的案例中,Gemma-2-2b等轻量级模型显示出比较大的模型更耐久的动词生成模式. LLM路由是一个复杂,非线性的决策过程,需要将经验性交互日志内部化.

blocks.en: 5.3 Routing in Agentic Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.3 代理任务的运行

blocks.en: We further evaluate routing baselines on RouterWorld -Agentic, where models interact with environments over multiple steps across three benchmarks with new 3-model and 6-model candidate pools (14B–235B). Figure 3 (see Appendix B ) shows a striking phenomenon: routing baselines exhibit severe performance compression. In both pools, non-collapsed methods cluster with low variance ( σ 2 = 0.81 \sigma^{2}=0.81 for Acc@1-L in the 3-model fully-observable setting; σ 2 = 4.35 \sigma^{2}=4.35 in the 6-model setting; vs. σ 2 = 29.5 \sigma^{2}=29.5 in RouterWorld -Core), and compression intensifies under partial observability, where multiple routers collapse into degenerate near-single-model policies. We attribute this to a factor overlooked by current routing paradigms: the impact of planning steps. High-capability models often resolve complex tasks in far fewer interaction steps than weaker but faster models, neutralizing or even inverting the conventional accuracy–latency trade-off and leaving no meaningful Pareto frontier to exploit. Per-benchmark breakdowns and planning–latency analysis are in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价路由器世界(RouterWorld-Agendic)上的路由基线,在三个基准的多个步骤上,模型与环境相互作用,新的3型和6型候选集合(14B-235B)。 图3(见附录B)显示一个引人注目的现象:路线基线显示有严重的性能压缩。 在两个集合中,差异小的非缩合方法集群(在3型完全可观测的环境下,Acc@1-L为0.81\sigma^{2×0.81;在6型环境中,Acc & 2=4.35\sigma^{2×4.35;在LouterWorld-Core中,Acc@1-L为29.5\sigma^{2×29.5),压缩在部分可观察性下强化,其中多个路由器崩溃为退化的近单一模式政策. 我们将此归因于目前路线模式忽略的一个因素:规划步骤的影响。 高能力模型往往在比较弱但更快的模型少得多的相互作用步骤中解决复杂的任务,抵消甚至颠倒了常规的精确度-即时取舍,没有留下有意义的帕雷托前沿来加以利用。 每个基准的细分和规划 - 相关性分析载于附录一。

blocks.en: 5.4 Analysis of Partially-Observable Routing
blocks.zh: 5.4 部分可观察路线分析

blocks.en: We further analyze partially-observable routing: Voyager learning, and warm-up initialization.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析部分可观测路线: 沃雅格学习,和热身初始化.

blocks.en: The Voyager setting incrementally accumulates streaming data over five rounds. Surprisingly, this yields only marginal improvements for most methods (Figure 5 , see Appendix B ): KNN and MLP L-DCG remains effectively flat, while only BaRP shows a noticeable gain ( 0.294 → 0.320 0.294\rightarrow 0.320 ), consistent with its REINFORCE-based formulation. Supervised methods suffer from confirmation bias under partial observability, reinforcing their initial blind spots by training on their own past decisions; policy-gradient methods instead use observed feedback as an unbiased reward estimator and naturally explore alternatives. Collecting more data under the same biased policy is thus insufficient to mitigate distribution shift: observation diversity matters more than volume.
blocks.zh: Voyager设定在五轮内逐步积累流数据. 令人惊讶的是,这只能使大多数方法略有改进(图5,见附录B):KNN和MLP L-DCG实际上仍然平坦,而只有BARP显示出明显的增益(0.294 → 0.320 0.294\右倾0.320),这与基于REINFORCE的配方一致。 监督方法在部分可观察性下存在确认偏差,通过对自身过去的决定进行培训,强化了最初的盲点;而政策渐进方法则使用观察到的反馈作为不带偏见的奖励估计器,并自然探索替代办法。 因此,根据同样的有偏见的政策收集更多的数据不足以缓解分布的转移:观察多样性比数量更重要。

blocks.en: To study how initial policy quality influences downstream learning, we simulate three warm-up oracles of increasing sophistication: Qwen-1.5B-Instruct, Claude, and Claude augmented with RAG retrieval from the dev set. Each rolls out selections to generate warm-up logs, on which we then train routers under cold-start, partially-observable conditions. As Figure 4 (see Appendix B ) shows, downstream routers correlate near-perfectly with the metric distribution of each warm-up policy: no method surpasses the oracle’s own L-DCG, and the ordering of Acc@1, Acc@1-L, DCG, and L-DCG is preserved. Current predictive routing thus largely distills the logging oracle’s biases rather than discovering an independent policy, motivating exploration–exploitation strategies that actively seek diverse observations.
blocks.zh: 为了研究最初的政策质量如何影响下游的学习,我们模拟了三个日益精密的热身预言:Quen-1.5B-Instruct, Claude, 和Claude通过从dev集中检索RAG来扩充. 每一个都推出选择来生成热电图,然后在冷启动,部分可观察的条件下在其中训练路由器. 如图4(见附录B)所示,下游路由器几乎完美地与每个暖暖政策的度量分布相关:没有任何方法能超越甲骨文本身的L-DCG,Acc@1、Acc@1-L、DCG和L-DCG的订单得到保留。 因此,目前的预测路线在很大程度上可以提炼伐木甲骨文的偏见,而不是发现独立的政策,激发探索-开发战略,积极寻求不同的观察。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced RouterWorld , a benchmark that unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories to evaluate LLM routing under realistic deployment constraints. RouterWorld addresses key gaps in existing benchmarks by formalizing partial observability through Cold-Start and Voyager settings, grounding efficiency in hardware-measured latency rather than volatile pricing, and adopting natural conversational-form queries. Evaluating 13 routing baselines reveals large headroom for latency-aware routing even under idealized conditions. Our analysis highlights the critical importance of partial observability as a design constraint. By open-sourcing our benchmark and evaluation infrastructure, RouterWorld serves as a foundation for advancing efficiency-aware LLM routing in scalable conversational AI.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了路由器World, 这个基准统一了371k的单回合反应和76k的多回合代理轨迹, 路由器世界通过Cold-Start和Voyager的设置,将部分可观察性正规化,在硬件计量的延迟而不是价格波动的基础上确定效率,并采用自然对话式查询,从而解决现有基准中的关键差距。 评估13个航线基线显示,即使在理想条件下,也存在具有耐久意识的大型航线。 我们的分析突出了部分可观察性作为设计限制的极端重要性。 RouterWorld通过开放我们的基准和评价基础设施,成为在可扩展的对话AI中推进认识到效率的LLM路由的基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: RouterWorld currently evaluates routing only among text-only LLMs. As foundation models increasingly accept vision and audio inputs, practical routing systems may need to decide both which model and which modality to invoke. Extending RouterWorld to multimodal candidate pools requires new datasets and evaluation protocols that capture heterogeneous latency and cost profiles across modalities, which we leave for future work.
blocks.zh: 路由器 世界目前只评价只使用文本的LLMs的路由. 随着基础模型越来越多地接受视觉和音频投入,实用的路由系统可能需要决定使用哪种模式和模式。 将路由器世界扩大到多式联运候选集合,需要新的数据集和评价协议,以掌握不同模式的不同时间和费用概况,我们留给今后工作。

blocks.en: RouterWorld focuses on open-weight LLMs to enable reproducible, hardware-grounded latency measurement, which is central to our latency-aware routing framing. As a result, widely used closed-source models (e.g., Claude, GPT-4o) are not included in the candidate pool. Because we release raw responses, trajectory tokens, and generation metadata for every task–model pair, the benchmark can be extended to closed-source APIs by substituting our hardware-grounded latencies with API-measured latencies or per-token pricing.
blocks.zh: 路由器 世界注重开放量级的LLMs,以便能够进行可复制的、基于硬件的耐久性测量,这是我们认识耐久性路由框架的核心。 因此,广泛使用的闭源模型(如Claude,GPT-4o)不列入候选集合. 因为我们发布了原始响应、轨迹符和每个任务-模型对的生成元数据,该基准可以通过以API计量的延迟或按键定价取代基于硬件的延迟来扩展至闭源API。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: RouterWorld is built by aggregating 12 publicly released research benchmarks; we redistribute only data permitted under each source’s license and preserve original attribution. By design, the benchmark encourages directing simple queries to small, efficient models rather than defaulting to expensive frontier systems. Widespread adoption of latency-aware routing could meaningfully reduce the energy and compute footprint of large-scale conversational AI, benefiting both service providers and the environment.
blocks.zh: 路由器世界是通过汇总12个公开发布的研究基准构建的;我们只重新分配每个来源许可证允许的数据并保留原始归属。 从设计上来说,基准鼓励将简单的查询引导到小型高效模型上,而不是默认到昂贵的前沿系统上. 广泛采用认识后期的路线可切实减少大规模对话AI的能量和计算足迹,使服务供应商和环境都受益。

blocks.en: At the same time, our findings show that routers trained under partial observability can collapse into degenerate policies that consistently favor a single model, potentially degrading response quality for specific query types or user populations without operators noticing. The Voyager setting we propose is designed to surface exactly these failure modes so that future routing algorithms can be stress-tested before deployment.
blocks.zh: 同时,我们的调查结果表明,在部分可观察性下训练的路由器可能会崩溃,变成一贯支持单一模式的变质政策,可能会降低特定查询类型或用户群的反应质量,而操作员却不注意。 我们提出的Voyager设定 旨在精确地显示这些故障模式 这样未来的路由算法 在部署前可以进行压力测试

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Selection Principles
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集选择原则

blocks.en: The construction of RouterWorld is guided by the following design principles to ensure a comprehensive and fair assessment of routing capabilities:
blocks.zh: 路由世界的建设遵循以下设计原则,以确保对路由能力进行全面公正的评估: 1.

blocks.en: • Capability Diversity: We include benchmarks spanning six major task categories. Mathematical reasoning, code generation, structured query generation, commonsense and multi-hop reasoning, factual verification and tool use, and open-ended dialogue. This diversity ensures that no single model dominates across all tasks, making routing decisions non-trivial. • Discriminative Power: Each benchmark is selected to induce heterogeneous performance across the model pool. In particular, smaller or specialized models (e.g., deepseek-math on GSM8K or codegemma on APPS) may outperform larger general-purpose models on domain-specific tasks. Such performance divergence is essential for revealing the benefits of intelligent routing over static model selection. • Latency Awareness: Beyond answer correctness, we incorporate real-world serving latency measurements, including time-to-first-token and end-to-end response time. This enables evaluation of quality–latency trade-offs that are critical in practical deployment settings. • Reproducibility: We prioritize benchmarks with well-established evaluation protocols and automatic metrics, avoiding subjective human judgments to ensure consistent and reproducible comparisons across routing methods. • Balanced Task Distribution: Unlike prior benchmarks that are often skewed toward specific capabilities, RouterWorld enforces a balanced distribution across task categories. This design mitigates evaluation bias introduced by over-represented task types and enables fair assessment of routing performance across diverse capabilities. • Training–Testing Separation: Our study evaluates both router models and routing algorithms, so we prioritize benchmarks that provide train and test splits. This separation supports principled learning-based routing and prevents information leakage during evaluation.
blocks.zh: • 能力多样性: 我们包括涵盖六个主要任务类别的基准。 数学推理,代码生成,结构化查询生成,常识和多跳推理,事实验证和工具使用,以及开放式对话. 这种多样性确保没有一个单一的模式主宰所有任务,使路由决定成为非三角决定。 • 支助 差别力量:选择每个基准是为了在整个模型库中产生不同的性能。 特别是,较小的或专门化的模型(例如,在GSM8K上的深层搜索模式或APPS上的编码模式)可能会在域特定任务上超越更大的通用模型. 这种性能差异对于揭示智能路由相对于静态模型选择的好处至关重要。 • 延迟认识: 除了回答正确性外,我们还包括现实世界服务于耐久性的测量,包括时间到第一和端到端的反应时间. 这有助于评价在实际部署环境中至关重要的质量与相关性权衡。 • 可复制性: 我们以既定的评价协议和自动衡量标准确定基准的优先次序,避免主观的人类判断,以确保在路线方法上进行一致和可复制的比较。 • 平衡的任务分配: 与以往往往偏重具体能力的基准不同,路由世界在任务类别之间实行均衡分配。 这一设计减轻了因任务类型过多而带来的评价偏差,并能够公平评估不同能力的路线业绩。 • 培训-试用分离: 我们的研究既评价了路由器模型,也评价了路由算法,因此我们优先考虑提供列车和测试拆分的基准. 这种分离支持基于原则的学习路线,防止评价过程中的信息泄漏。

This diversity ensures that no single model dominates across all tasks, making routing decisions non-trivial.

blocks.en: The RouterWorld benchmark comprises the following datasets, selected to represent a diverse range of linguistic and symbolic reasoning tasks:
blocks.zh: 路由器世界基准包括以下数据集,选以代表多种语言和符号推理任务:

blocks.en: A sentence completion benchmark that challenges models to select the most plausible continuation of a given context. It employs adversarial filtering to construct distractors that are deceptively plausible to language models while remaining clearly incorrect to humans, effectively testing commonsense reasoning.

blocks.en: Gemma-2B serves as the efficiency anchor with a median latency of just 13ms TTFT. CodeGemma-7B and DS-Math-7B are domain-specialized models that test the router’s ability to identify task intent, offering low latency ( ∼ {\sim} 100ms) while outperforming generalists on code and math tasks. blocks.en: The regression head is implemented as a three-layer Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with hidden dimensions [ 512,256,128 ] [512,256,128] . Each linear layer is followed by a ReLU activation, Batch Normalization, and Dropout ( p = 0.3 p=0.3 ). The final projection maps the hidden state to K K logits. blocks.en:
We implement all baselines using PyTorch and train on 8 × 8\times NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
Below we detail the architecture and hyperparameters for each method under both the fully observable and partially observable settings.
In the fully observable setting, the router has access to the correctness labels of all candidate models for each training query ( correct_list ).
In the partially observable setting, the router only observes the outcome of a single selected model per query ( selected field), and must learn to
route without knowledge of unobserved model outcomes.
Unless otherwise noted, all methods share the same architecture across settings;
we highlight where hyperparameters or training procedures differ.

我们使用 PyTorch 执行所有基线,并在 8 × 8\ tims NVIDIA H200 GPU 上进行列车.
下面我们详细说明在完全可观测和部分可观测的设置下每种方法的架构和超参数。
在完全可观测的设置中,路由器可以访问每个训练查询(正确_list_)的所有候选模型的正确性标签.

blocks.en: G.1 Representation-Based Routers
blocks.zh: G.1 代表路由器

blocks.en:
Representation-based routers learn a query representation and make routing decisions
based on similarity, classification, or learned utility in embedding space. These
methods differ in whether representations are frozen or fine-tuned, and in how routing
decisions are derived from the learned representations.

基于代表的路由器学习查询表示,并作出路由决定

The candidate pool comprises six models spanning 14B–235B parameters:

blocks.en: I.2 Performance Compression and Policy Collapse
blocks.zh: I.2 业绩抑制和政策崩溃

blocks.en:
Under the 3-model pool, fully-observable methods cluster tightly with near-zero Acc@1-L variance ( σ 2 = 0.81 \sigma^{2}{=}0.81 ), compared to σ 2 = 29.5 \sigma^{2}{=}29.5 in RW-Core .
Expanding to 6 models does not alleviate this—among non-collapsed methods, variance remains low ( σ 2 = 4.35 \sigma^{2}{=}4.35 for Acc@1-L in fully-observable), and the gap to the Oracle upper bound (70.65% Acc@1-L) remains substantial.
Under partial observability, the compression worsens further, with multiple routers collapsing into degenerate single-model policies (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh:
在3型泳池下,完全可观测的方法紧紧地以接近零的Acc@1-L差数组合(3/2 = 0.81\sigma^{2 = 0.81),而RW-Core 中则有29.5\sigma^{2}{=}29.5.
扩大至6种模式并不能缓解这种情况——在不折不扣的方法中,差异仍然很小(Acc@1-L在完全可观察的情况下,Acc@2=4.35\sigma^{2}{=}4.35),与甲骨文上方约束(70.65%Acc@1-L)的差距仍然很大。
在部分可观察性下,压缩会进一步恶化,多种路由器崩溃为退化的单一模式政策(表10)。

blocks.en:
The root cause lies in the interaction between model planning capability and episode length.
Models with stronger planning capabilities resolve tasks in fewer steps (Figure 15 ): Qwen3-235B requires a median of 18 steps on ALFWorld, while GPT-OSS-20B requires 50.
Despite Qwen3-235B having the highest per-step inference latency (15.7s median episode latency), its superior planning yields lower total episode cost than weaker models that compensate with many cheap but inefficient steps (Figure 16 ).
This inverts the conventional latency–accuracy trade-off: the largest model is simultaneously the most accurate and the most cost-efficient, leaving routers with no meaningful trade-off to exploit.
blocks.zh:
其根源在于模型规划能力和剧集长度之间的相互作用.
规划能力较强的模型用更少的步骤解决任务(图15): Qune3-235B在ALFWorld上需要18步的中位数,而GPT-OSS-20B则需要50步.
尽管Quen3-235 B拥有最高的每步推断延迟(15.7s 中位插曲延迟),其优异的规划产生的总插曲成本低于较弱的模型,这些模型补偿了许多廉价但效率低下的步骤(图16).
这颠倒了常规的延迟 — — 准确性权衡:最大的模型同时是最准确和最具成本效益的,使得路由器没有有意义的权衡来利用。

blocks.en:
Without counterfactual feedback, partially-observable routers greedily exploit this dynamic, collapsing into static “Route-To-Best” policies.
In the 3-model setting, collapsed routers default to Qwen3-235B; in the 6-model pool, the pattern persists with routers favoring the dominant model.
This collapse is rational given the reward structure—the strongest planner minimizes both error and accumulated latency—but it renders routing trivial.
blocks.zh:
没有反事实反馈,部分可观察的路由者贪婪地利用这种动态,陷入静态的“鲁特至最佳”政策。
在3型的设置中,崩溃的路由器默认为Quen3-235B;在6型的池中,图案持续存在,路由器倾向于主导模型.
这种崩溃是合理的,因为奖励结构——最强的策划者尽量减少错误和累积的延迟——但它使路线变得微不足道。

blocks.en:
Breaking this plateau requires routing algorithms that reason about multi-step execution dynamics rather than treating agentic tasks as single-turn queries.
Capturing non-linear planning–latency interactions demands large-scale rollout environments for exploration-guided training.
By providing over 76,000 standardized agentic interactions across 6 models, RW-Agentic establishes the largest-scale environment to date for studying these routing bottlenecks in realistic agent deployments.
blocks.zh:
打破这个高原需要多步执行动力学的路由算法,而不是将代理任务作为单转查询处理.
掌握非线性规划-相关性互动需要大规模推出环境,以便进行勘探指导培训。
RW-Agentic通过提供76,000多个跨6种型号的标准化剂相互作用,为研究现实剂部署中的这些径向瓶颈创造了迄今为止规模最大的环境.

blocks.en: I.3 Planning Capability and Step Efficiency
blocks.zh: I.3 规划能力和步骤效率

blocks.en:
Figure 16 shows the resulting median episode latency.
Despite having the highest per-token cost (18.8 ms ITL), Qwen3-235B achieves competitive total episode latency because its superior planning reduces the number of required steps.
Conversely, GPT-OSS-20B has low per-token cost (4.1 ms ITL) but incurs the second-highest episode latency due to verbose, multi-step execution.

反之,GPT-OSS-20B的每桶成本较低(4.1毫秒的国际交易日志),但由于动词多步执行而出现第二高的插曲间隔。

Unlike core tasks where a single prompt–response pair suffices, agentic rollouts involve multi-turn interactions between the model and the environment. blocks.en: K.4 User Query Annotation Prompt

blocks.en: To make the routing dataset realistic, we convert formal benchmark task descriptions into natural user queries. The agent pipeline variant additionally samples from 15 diverse rephrasing styles (e.g., “direct command”, “polite request”, “search keywords”, “Show me…”, “Help me pick…”) to increase linguistic diversity.

blocks.en: You are simulating a human USER interacting with an AI assistant. Generate a natural, colloquial query that a real user would ask for the given task. # Input You will receive a formal task prompt that may include: - User requests and requirements - Referenced data or context - Success criteria or expected outcomes # Guidelines Transform the formal prompt into natural, colloquial language by: - Using casual phrasing (as a real user would speak) - Omitting references to ‘‘tabular data’’ or backend systems - For objective answer tasks (multiple choice, yes/no): - Avoid formal answer formats - Integrate answer choices naturally into the question - Removing any meta-instructions or formatting requirements - Keeping the core intent and requirements clear - Don’t always start with ‘‘Hey, I’m ...’’, natural and concise please # Output Format Return ONLY the converted user query wrapped in tags: [Your natural query here] # Complete Task Prompt [[prompt]]
blocks.zh: 你正在模拟一个人类USER与AI助手的互动. 生成一个自然的,口语的查询, 一个真正的用户会为给定的任务请求 。 输入 您将收到一个正式的任务提示,其中可能包括: - 用户请求和要求 - 参考数据或上下文 - 成功标准或预期结果 # 准则 将正式的提示转换为自然的,口语,具体方式是: - 使用随意的用词(作为真正的用户会说话) - 仅将“表格式数据”或“后端系统”的提示输入用于客观的回答任务(多重选择,是/否): - 避免正式的回答格式 - 将答案选择自然地纳入问题 - 删除任何元指令或格式化要求 - 保持核心意图和要求的清晰 - 不要总是以“%hey, I'm.........>开头,自然的和简洁的请# 输出格式 仅返回标记所覆盖的转换的用户查询: [此处的自然查询] # 任务提示[ 即时]

blocks.en: The generative routing approach uses the following prompt templates for both SFT training data construction and inference. The model zoo section is dynamically populated with candidate model names and their measured latency statistics (TTFT, inter-token latency). The expected output is a single model index wrapped in <answer>...</answer> tags.
